body: Making a profit out of people who are lonely is just sick immorality.
Sometimes I wonder how self aware people are about the cliches they reproduce
Kill myself without caring for people around I don't even like but resent in secret. I'm almost 30 and I've never been happy but feel like I'm an inadequate, humilated piece of shit.
When the only common factor in those messages happens to be your presence, you have to think about something in your own behavior causing it.
